sources.title: GitHub - OpenBMB/MiniCPM-Robot: A Smarter and Faster On-Device AI Brain ...
sources.snippet: The model supports up to 1 minute of visual context memory while keeping online cost comparable to traditional single-frame reactive inference. Efficient Inference: Inherits MiniCPM-V 4.6's visual token compression, reducing each frame from 256 to 64 visual tokens for 4× compression.
